title: 第十三章 生存
content_zh:
生存是需要自己去争取的。

    在B区的酒馆里，所有的贵族都围着一张桌子，桌前坐的却大多是人类。

    “为什么我们不可以回去？”多力已经喝完了杯中的酒，借着酒劲，竟然对B区的负责人吼了起来。

    “不是不可以，而是我劝你们不要冒险，如果说刚才你们在门把上看到了水怪，那么，我想其它的变异生物一定也都进来了，所以为了安全，我劝你们先在B区呆几天，我想它们不会呆太久，如果没有吃的，它们很快便会离开。”负责人神情凝重，完全没有开玩笑的意思。

    “如果它们不离开呢？”艾勒维格问。

    “我想应该会离开的，毕竟在外面他们没有吃的。”说到在外面三个字时，所有人的脸色都有些异样，虽然刚才已经出去检查过，可是没有人敢肯定，在B区内真的没有第二个变异生物。

    “如果我们非要离开呢？”艾妮尔面无表情的问。

    “那么很可能你们会全部被吞食，成为异变生物们过冬的养料。”对方并没有因为艾妮尔的不知天高地厚而轻视，诚恳的回答。

    “原来如此。”艾妮尔点了点头，“那为什么刚才它不吞食我？”

    “这……”这个问题大家都很好奇，可是大家也都清楚，问谁都是白问，没有人知道，因为这是第一个特例。

    “也许你很特别。”负责人只想到这一个解释。

    “那么说，我回去也不会有事。”说着，艾妮尔起身便向门口走去。

    “等等！”

    “我走外面！”艾妮尔回头冷冷一笑，径直走向了那扇通向阳光的大门。

    “你不要命啦！”负责人伸手去拉，结果被萨尔一把抓住，“放心！阳光伤不了她。”

    “怎么可能！”对方完全不信，不过被萨尔抓着的手，还是乖乖的收了回来，毕竟那种疼痛让他有些惊心。

    “可是外面会不会也有变异生物？”正当艾妮尔准备推门而出时，艾勒维格阴不阴阳不阳的冒出这么一句，让艾妮尔伸出的手又收了回来，回头，“有又怎么样？”

    “不怎么样！我只是想提醒你一声，变异生物的品种应该不少，既然变异了，那么一切都会变，一般来说，都是数倍的增强，不论是数量，还是力量。”艾勒维格说的很平静，可是他的话让在场的每一位都心里发毛，原来B区的居民们本是心有余悸，而新来的他们，因为未知，就更加恐惧。

    “那么你说我们应该怎么办？”尼克没开过口，只是一个劲的喝着烈酒，直到此时。

    “我觉得出去不是个好办法。”艾勒维格微微的抿了一口杯中的酒。

    “那就等！”负责人一直站在这一边。

    “等一个冬天？如果它们没被冻死，到时春季苏醒之时，我想一定会更饥饿，说不定我们这里所有的人都不够它们填肚子的。”艾勒维格继续道。

    “那你说怎么办？走也不是，等又不行！”有的贵族已经开始沉不住气。
content_en:
Survival needs to be fought for by oneself.

    In the tavern in Area B, all the nobles gathered around a table, but most of the people sitting at the table were humans.

    "Why can't we go back?" Duoli had already finished the wine in his glass, and with the strength of the wine, he actually yelled at the person in charge of Area B.

    "It's not impossible, but I advise you not to take risks. If you saw the water monster on the doorknob just now, then I think other mutated creatures must have come in, so for safety, I advise you to stay in Area B for a few days. I don't think they will stay for long. If there is no food, they will leave soon." The person in charge looked solemn and was not joking at all.

    "What if they don't leave?" Ellevig asked.

    "I think they will leave. After all, they have nothing to eat outside." When the word "outside" was mentioned, everyone's expressions were a little strange. Although they had gone out to check just now, no one was sure that there was really no second mutant creature in Area B.

    "What if we have to leave?" Enel asked expressionlessly.

    "Then it is very likely that you will all be swallowed up and become nourishment for the mutated creatures to spend the winter." The other party did not look down upon Enel because of her ignorance, and answered sincerely.

    "I see." Enel nodded, "Then why didn't it swallow me just now?"

    "This..." Everyone is curious about this question, but everyone also knows that asking anyone is in vain. No one knows, because this is the first special case.

    "Maybe you are special." The person in charge could only think of this explanation.

    "Then, nothing will happen if I go back." With that said, Enel stood up and walked towards the door.

    "Wait!"

    "I'll go outside!" Enel turned around and smiled coldly, walking straight towards the door leading to the sun.

    "You don't want your life!" The person in charge reached out to pull her, but Sal grabbed her. "Don't worry! The sun can't hurt her."

    "How is that possible!" The other party didn't believe it at all, but he still took the hand held by Sal obediently. After all, the pain frightened him.

    "But are there mutated creatures outside?" Just as Enel was about to push the door open, Ellevig said this in a shady tone, causing Enel to retract her outstretched hand and turn around, "So what?"

    "Not so good! I just want to remind you that there should be many varieties of mutated creatures. Since they have mutated, everything will change. Generally speaking, it will be enhanced several times, whether it is quantity or strength." Ellevig said very calmly, but his words made everyone present feel scared. It turned out that the residents of Area B were still afraid, but the newcomers were even more frightened because of the unknown.

    "So what do you think we should do?" Nick didn't say anything, he just kept drinking strong drinks until now.

    "I don't think it's a good idea to go out." Ellevig took a slight sip of the wine in his glass.

    "Then wait!" The person in charge has been standing on this side.

    "Wait for a winter? If they are not frozen to death, I think they will be even hungrier when they wake up in the spring. Maybe all the people here are not enough for them to fill their stomachs." Ellerweg continued.

    "Then what do you think we should do? We can't leave, and we can't wait!" Some nobles were already losing their temper.
